entities.name: Miloš Macourek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Miloš Macourek was a Czech screenwriter and writer. Early in his career, he also wrote poems and plays. He was valued for his great imagination and sense of humor. He is known primarily for his books and films for children and for film comedies.
